description: Scores a payment system operator’s or overseer’s self-assessment against the 24 CPMI-IOSCO Principles (Apr 2012) or the 5 responsibilities of relevant authorities, on the methodology’s four-level scale plus not_applicable (Dec 2012), with this tool’s illustrative proportional tiers (systemic, prominent, small), a gap register, a date-ordered action plan, and an optional linked fast payment system governance module (CPMI Oct 2024 §4). Values only; never evidence.
